description: This file is a bundled Webpack worker script that defines functions for building Terser minification options, handling comments during minification, and performing minification using the Terser library. It exports a minify function and requires external Terser module.

methods.name: buildTerserOptions
methods.description: Constructs Terser minification options based on provided parameters.

methods.name: buildComments
methods.description: Creates a function to handle comment extraction and preservation during minification.

methods.name: minify
methods.description: Performs JavaScript minification using Terser with specified options.
